ui_bugs.issue: The 'Kelola Kategori' modal has NO visible close mechanism: no X button, no Cancel/Tutup button, no backdrop-click handler, and Escape key is not wired. Once opened, the user is trapped until they navigate away or reload. The generic <Modal> component only closes via ModalButtons (rendered for bill/bulk/pay forms), but the cats modal does not include ModalButtons. Bill/Bulk/Pay modals are OK because they have Batal button.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' Emerges from the app's automated instrumentation (x-source-editable wrapper spans injected inside <option>). Non-blocking for functionality, but noisy in console. Likely dev-only tooling.

action_items: Add a close mechanism to the Kelola Kategori modal (X icon in header, or Tutup button, or onClick on the backdrop that calls onClose). Suggest adding an X button to the shared <Modal> component so all modals get it for free. Currently users cannot dismiss the categories modal via UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Spp.jsx <Modal> component (lines 386-395) has no built-in close affordance (no X, no click-outside). Cancel behavior depends on child forms rendering <ModalButtons>. The cats modal (lines 353-370) omits ModalButtons and therefore cannot be closed by the user.

Console hydration warning about <span> inside <option> on Spp.jsx (bill-student, bill-category, bulk-category, bulk-class, flt-class) — likely caused by tooling wrapper spans, but if the codebase renders any real child element inside <option>, React will complain. Consider ensuring option content is a plain text expression only.

rca of the issue: Kelola Kategori modal untrappable: The reusable Modal component in Spp.jsx does not render an internal close button and has no onClick handler on the backdrop. The bill/bulk/pay modals happen to include a <ModalButtons> footer that provides a 'Batal' button which calls onClose, but the categories modal uses a custom body without ModalButtons, leaving no path to invoke setModal(null). Mitigation: (a) add an X icon button inside <Modal> header wired to onClose, and/or (b) add onClick to the outer backdrop that closes when e.target === e.currentTarget, and/or (c) add a Tutup/Selesai button to the cats modal body.
